Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent accepted the prior unsourced prices as “verified” based only on plausibility from historical ranges, misinterpreting the verification requirement and misusing upstream data (Rule 2). This set the wrong inputs and produced the incorrect $120 savings, steering subsequent steps toward the wrong conclusion; while termination later cemented it, this was the first decisive misstep leading to the error (Rule 3). Loop considerations are not central here (Rule 1).

  downstream_usage:
  - data_item: "Daily ticket price 2024: $60"
